buildings.name: Foreign Palace
buildings.other: Foreign Exhibits (arch lettering at fair time, PH037 b228 Z01530); Liberal Arts Bldg. (Angelus captions Jan-Apr 1905; arch lettered LIBERAL ARTS in Mar 1905, b225 00794)
buildings.heights: 46 ft to the eaves, 56 ft to the top (Sanborn printed heights); 6 towers or domes, up to 102 ft
buildings.evidence: The twin-tower hall at the head of the grand stair: square towers with arcaded belvederes and low pyramidal roofs, a great carved arch over three doors, quatrefoil panels, an arcaded gallery. Lettered LIBERAL ARTS in Mar 1905 (b225 00794, 00799) and FOREIGN EXHIBITS at fair time (b228 Z01530, night, with a two-tier fountain in an octagonal basin in front). It stands against the Oriental Building's apse end (b225 00725).
